Metadata.title: Hide Kindle Orders
Metadata.description: A Firefox extension that hides Kindle orders on the Amazon.co.jp order history page.

Hero.description: A Firefox extension that hides Kindle orders on your Amazon.co.jp order history, one click at a time.

toggle.title: One-click toggle
toggle.description: A button in the bottom right flips hiding on and off. The choice is remembered.

infiniteScroll.title: Infinite scroll ready
infiniteScroll.description: Pages appended by Infy Scroll and friends are filtered too.

privacy.title: No data collection
privacy.description: Everything happens on the page. Nothing is sent anywhere.
